Scholarship overview

Sussex's AHRC Doctoral Landscape Awards support research in arts and humanities. Applicants seek a competitive doctoral scholarship through the university's call. International applicants should pay particular attention to the tuition difference, because the award covers fees at the home rate.

Research Areas

  • Arts and humanities
  • History
  • Doctoral research

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails
Award or positionPhD scholarship / studentship
Stipend / salaryGBP 21,805/year (2026/27 reference rate)
TuitionHome-rate fees only; international fee difference not covered

Eligibility and Requirements

CriterionRequirement
Applicant eligibilityWorldwide, subject to programme rules
Further conditionsFunding covers home-rate fees; international tuition difference is not covered.

Application dates

ComponentDetails
Recruitment statusOpen
Deadline / consideration round10 December 2026
LocationUnited Kingdom

About University of Sussex

Sussex offers research degrees across arts, humanities, sciences and social sciences. Its funded doctoral calls are coordinated through university research schools and external funding partnerships.
